enumeration.criterion: Every sources.json entry with completed_character_count == 0, enumerated programmatically across research/batch_*/**/sources.json.

exact_bounded_witness_or_continuity.detail: Each audit names a single edition, release, rules product, bounded opening segment, or clearly separated publisher-metadata witness. None was treated as an exhaustive franchise census.

nonzero_cited_source_terms.detail: SRC-071, SRC-072, and SRC-084 were the only zero-term bundles. Each now has one narrow, citation-backed bibliographic or scope-boundary term; no lore or characters were invented.

authoritative_citations.detail: The audited records use declared first-party publisher, developer, licensor, official store/manual, author-authorized, or primary-text witnesses. The review retained access limitations where those witnesses do not expose claim-level character evidence.

zero_character_reason_omissions_and_unce.detail: Every pass expressly explains why no stable named dramatic individual is in scope or supportable, and preserves omissions/uncertainties for avatars, procedural play, unlicensed text access, adaptation boundaries, translations, and scope separation.

completion_status_nonexhaustive.detail: All pass-complete labels are constrained by their declared witness/coverage rule. SRC-071, SRC-072, and SRC-084 use evidence-insufficient-zero-character-audit instead of suggesting that a whole novel or franchise has been exhaustively researched.

review_groups.group: bounded fiction, manga, or publisher-metadata witnesses
review_groups.result: retained zeroes: either the precise primary segment contains no named individual (SRC-037), or the accessible authorized witness is edition/premise metadata rather than a claim-level chapter, page, panel, or individual dossier.
retained zeroes: the cited official materials support edition, player-avatar, procedural, package, or setting/mechanics claims but not reproducible named-NPC profiles with claim-level locators.

review_groups.group: licensed tabletop rules and setting-product witnesses
review_groups.result: retained terms-only zeroes: core rules, setting catalogues, and emergent-fiction systems have no audited fixed character cohort in the selected accessible witness. Named persons require separately scoped official profiles, scenarios, or literary witnesses.

retained terms-only zeroes: cards, roles, factions, player-controlled panels, miniatures, and variable campaign outcomes are not automatically stable dramatic-character records. Several are flagged below for a richer official profile check.

unresolved_cases: SRC-071 and SRC-072 remain deliberately evidence-insufficient: no accessible primary Korean/Japanese text or complete authoritative translation was available for character-level claims.
SRC-084 remains deliberately evidence-insufficient: the authorized work page identifies the novel and its fictional framing but is not a stable primary-text witness.

The eleven flagged sources are not defects remediable from the present citations. They require a separate, directly accessible official character/profile or primary-text witness; no weak character record was added.

For procedural, avatar-led, collaborative, and board-game systems, a named card, class, faction, or player role remains insufficient unless a future witness directly establishes a stable dramatic individual.
